overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus 3-Person Corner Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a spacious, rejuvenating retreat right in your home. Designed for wellness, it features 9 strategically placed Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels that promote muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Constructed from elegant Canadian Hemlock wood with a bronze-tinted tempered glass door, this sauna is perfect for indoor spaces like basements or fitness rooms. Enjoy the added luxury of an interior chromotherapy lighting system and built-in Bluetooth speakers for a truly immersive experience.
